The '''Sprinkler''' is a [[Crafting|crafted]] item that waters 4 tiles (above, below, and to the right and left of it) every morning. Only tilled tiles will be watered. The Sprinkler is unlocked at [[Farming]] level 2.

[[Crafting#Sprinklers|Sprinklers]] can water [[Slime Hutch]] troughs, but cannot be used to water [[Garden Pot]]s or the [[Animals#Cat or Dog|pet's]] water bowl. Sprinklers cannot be placed on sand.

A [[Torch]] can be placed on a Sprinkler to provide minimal lighting in the dark.

[[File:Sprinklerexample.png|140px]]

{{#lst:Crafting|craftingsprinklers}}

==Upgrades==
<section begin="upgrades" />
Upgrades can be attached onto a placed sprinkler. Picking up the sprinkler will remove the upgrade without destroying it.

Only one upgrade can be used at a time on a single sprinkler.
